description: This file is an OpenCart admin controller class for managing the 'Latest' module, including viewing, saving, adding, and deleting module configurations.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Latest module in the OpenCart admin panel, handling display, save, add, and delete actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the Latest module, including breadcrumbs, form data, and view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration, including permission checks, validation, and saving to the database.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Latest module with default settings and returns success or error response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific module instance based on module_id, with permission validation.
